However, the department also alleged that the information was received that M/s Illusion Dental Laboratory Pvt Ltd (PAN -AABCI3029F), that had been amalgamated with Laxmi Dental Ltd. (Formerly Laxmi Dental Export Pvt. Ltd.) w.e.f 01.04.2017, had entered into the certain high value transactions even though the entity of M/s Illusion Dental Laboratory Pvt Ltd was not in existence during the FY 2018-19.
